end.chapter: Economic Geography — Natural Regions: 1. Equatorial Regions
end.title: The Equatorial Region: Types of Resources and Methods of Exploitation
end.coverNote: Good morning, class. Today we look at the resources of the Equatorial Region and how people exploit them
end.notions: Resource, exploitation, timber, hydro-electricity, petroleum, cash crop, wildlife.
end.focus: Types of resources of the Equatorial region and methods of exploitation (progression sheet, week 4).
end.competence: Learners are able to name the resources of the Equatorial region and describe how they are exploited.
objectives: Name the main resources of the Equatorial region.
Describe the methods used to exploit each resource.
recall: The Equatorial region has a thick forest with hardwood trees.
Its soils are poor, but its climate is good for many crops.
end.recallNote: Check the homework on forest products sold in the market of Garoua.
end.justification: This lesson helps us to know the riches of the Equatorial region and how people use them.
end.homework: Ask a farmer or a trader what crops come from the forest region of Cameroon. Write three food crops and two cash crops.
end.homeworkTag: This prepares Lesson 1 (Part 4): human activities of the Equatorial region.
